title: Introduce provisioning wobble attenuator and utilization report normalizer
author: Asha Patel
body:
Problem: The fleet provisioner occasionally oscillates (fast scale up followed by rapid scale down) when tenants concurrently change committed capacity or when burst requests cluster. Root cause analysis shows two interacting feedback loops: short-window utilization spikes trigger immediate reservation adjustments, while downstream allocator eager preemption produces downstream utilization dips that feed back into the controller, causing a wobble. This PR adds a "provisioning wobble attenuator" that reduces reactivity for short-lived utilization spikes while preserving throughput guarantees. It also introduces a utilization report normalizer to remove sampling artefacts from the percentile reports used by commitment reconciler.

Summary of changes:
- New stabilizer package (pkg/provisioner/stabilizer.go) implementing a two-stage smoothing: reservoir smoothing + asymmetric hysteresis. The controller uses a rate-limited apply path to avoid thrash.
- Introduce CommitWobbleIndex metric and promql extractor (pkg/metrics/commit_wobble_index.promql) used by alerting and dashboards.
- Utilization normalizer (pkg/telemetry/utilization_normalizer.go) that debounces shard-level sampling noise and tags stabilized series for downstream consumers.
- Autoscaler config knobs (configs/autoscaler/stabilizer.yaml) to tune short-burst damping and steady-state aggressiveness per pool.
- Integration tests (e2e/provisioner/stability_test.go) that replay historical spike traces and assert SLA adherence and absence of oscillation.
- Docs and dashboard updates (docs/observability/provisioner-metrics.md, dashboard/provisioner-wobble.json).

Behavior and safety notes:
- Defaults are conservative: wobble attenuator disabled for pools with >99.99% uptime SLAs unless explicitly enabled by ops.
- All changes behind a feature flag: feature.provisioner.wobble_attenuator.
- The new code path is covered by unit+integration tests; e2e uses recorded traces from incidents/2026-01-22 to validate regression.

Testing:
- Unit suite: 84 new unit tests, local run passes.
- e2e: stability tests added; CI replay harness ran on a 3-node test fleet in seat-labs.
- Prometheus rules updated and verified in staging dashboards.

Related work: ENG-4210 (wobble detection), ENG-4211 (telemetry normalization), SUP-3345 (post-incident follow-up), and previous autoscaler smoothing PRs.

Checklist:
- [x] Code compiles and unit tests pass
- [x] Integration / e2e tests for stability
- [x] Feature flag controlled
- [x] Docs updated
- [x] Telemetry / dashboards updated

Wire stabilizer into provisioner apply path and add feature flag toggle
Add utilization normalizer and tagger for downstream consumers

Add autoscaler config knobs and defaults
Integration test: replay historic spike traces and assertions

review_comments: Diego Ramos (2026-03-01): Can we avoid double-counting when normalizer tags series? If normalizer emits both raw and normalized series downstream it might inflate quota evaluation. Request: add a clear contract in telemetry README and an opt-in tag for consumers.

Asha Patel (2026-03-01 reply): Good point, I added an explicit tag 'normalized=true' and updated docs to indicate downstream consumers should prefer normalized series. Also gated emission behind feature flag for staging only.
Nina Kapoor (2026-03-02): Tests look solid. Please add an integration-level assert that the CommitWobbleIndex stays < 0.02 for 95th percentile of the replayed trace; otherwise LGTM.
Asha Patel (2026-03-03 reply): Added assertion and updated replay trace to include a longer tail. CI e2e passes now.
Liam O'Connor (2026-03-04): Small nits on comments and a suggestion to expose knob via Console UI rather than only YAML. Not blocking.
Asha Patel (2026-03-04 reply): Filed ENG-4228 for Console knob work and added a TODO in configs comment.
release_notes: Introduce a conservative provisioner stabilizer (wobble attenuator) and utilization normalization. Feature-flagged, default off for critical SLA pools. Adds CommitWobbleIndex metric and observability updates.
